items.title: Dzulkefly ‘Commits’ To Forming Health Service Commission Without Power To Create Positions Or Set Emoluments
items.summary: Dr Dzul commits to forming a Health Service Commission (SPK), but says it won't be able to create positions, devise a retirement scheme, or set emoluments. items.title: Penang Hits Ambulance Response Target With Community Responders
items.summary: State exco Daniel Gooi says Penang is the only state that has achieved the national ambulance response target, due to community responders.
